title: ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations
summary: Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.
tldr: ForeAct repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency robotic control, using learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation for action generation. It achieves high success rates on LIBERO, SimplerEnv-Bridge, and real-world rollouts without needing depth input or an external geometry backbone.
tldr_zh: ForeAct 将预训练的视频世界模型重新用作低延迟机器人控制的单次前向表示骨干，通过由下一帧相对深度监督的可学习标记来塑造共享视频表示以生成动作。在 LIBERO、SimplerEnv-Bridge 和真实世界 rollout 上取得了高成功率，且无需深度输入或外部几何骨干。
summary_zh: 机器人操作需要一种能够同时捕捉场景几何结构及其在交互过程中演变的表征方式。现有方法在很大程度上将这两个方面分开处理。世界动作模型通过将动作预测与未来视频生成相结合来捕捉此类动态，但其对迭代扩散或纠偏流推理的依赖导致计算成本高昂，同时其表征缺乏显式的空间结构。显式建模场景几何通常需要辅助模块，这会同时增加参数量和计算开销。相反，以几何为中心的策略主要恢复观测到的空间结构，且往往缺乏对交互过程中未来几何变化的显式监督。为解决这些局限，我们提出了ForeAct，该方法将预训练的视频世界模型重新用作单次前向传播的表征主干，以实现低延迟控制。ForeAct在单次前向传播中直接处理当前观测的干净潜在表示，省去了未来帧合成和迭代去噪过程，同时保留了主干网络预训练得到的时空先验。ForeAct并未引入独立的几何主干，而是使用由下一帧相对深度监督的可学习令牌，通过双向自注意力机制塑造共享的视频表征。这一紧凑接口将主干网络中已编码的空间知识转化为面向动作生成的未来感知表征，且参数量开销极小。轻量级几何读取模块仅在训练阶段使用，部署时移除，从而实现了无需深度输入或外部几何主干的低延迟、几何感知控制。在不进行额外大规模预训练的情况下，ForeAct在LIBERO上取得96.6%的平均成功率，在SimplerEnv-Bridge上达到63.5%，并在90次真实世界 rollout 中实现了74.4%的成功率。

title: Zero-Shot VLA Adaptation with Retrieved Guidance
summary: Pre-training large parametric "Vision-Language-Action" (VLA) models on large demonstration datasets has recently yielded promising results for general-purpose manipulation. However, these models still struggle under even small domain shifts relative to the training data, such as changes in camera viewpoint, background, object identity, or robot morphology. Motivated by the success of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in language models, we pursue retrieval to boost VLA performance. Specifically, we seek to leverage retrieval from domain-mismatched, "in-the-wild" demonstration datasets like DROID to guide a VLA's behavior in a new target domain. To achieve this, we introduce RAGu, which overcomes robotics-specific challenges for RAG: (1) It incorporates simple geometric calibration to transform source demonstrations into the target setup and reduce cross-domain differences. (2) It uses a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy that selects, from a large pool of pre-warped candidates, the trajectory most compatible with the base VLA. (3) It guides the VLA's flow-matching inference procedure rather than seeking to retrain the base model or expand its limited context window. We evaluate RAGu across real-world, simulation, sim-to-real transfer, and cross-embodiment humanoid manipulation. We find it improves real-world VLA success rates from 20% to 80% and outperforms the closest-related baselines in sim. Project website: raguvla.github.io
tldr: RAGu introduces a retrieval-augmented generation framework for zero-shot VLA adaptation, using geometric calibration, coarse-to-fine retrieval, and flow-matching guidance to improve manipulation success under domain shifts.
tldr_zh: RAGu 提出了一种用于零样本 VLA 适应的检索增强生成框架，通过几何校准、粗到细检索和流匹配引导，在域偏移下提升操作成功率。
summary_zh: 在大型示范数据集上预训练大规模参数化“视觉-语言-动作”（VLA）模型，近期在通用操作任务中取得了令人鼓舞的成果。然而，这些模型在面对与训练数据相比即使是微小的领域偏移时，仍表现不佳，例如相机视角、背景、物体身份或机器人形态的变化。受检索增强生成（RAG）在语言模型中取得成功的启发，我们探索利用检索来提升VLA的性能。具体而言，我们旨在利用来自领域不匹配的“野外”示范数据集（如DROID）的检索结果，来引导VLA在新目标领域中的行为。为实现这一目标，我们提出了RAGu，它克服了RAG在机器人领域面临的特定挑战：（1）引入简单的几何校准，将源域示范转换到目标设置，以减少跨域差异；（2）采用由粗到细的检索策略，从大量预变形候选中选择与基础VLA最兼容的轨迹；（3）引导VLA的流匹配推理过程，而非重新训练基础模型或扩展其有限的上下文窗口。我们在真实世界、仿真、仿真到真实迁移以及跨形态人形操作中评估了RAGu。我们发现，它将真实世界中VLA的成功率从20%提升至80%，并在仿真中超越了最相近的基线方法。项目网站：raguvla.github.io

title: Breaking survivorship bias in driving world models
summary: World models allow autonomous vehicles to imagine the consequences of candidate actions before execution, but their reliability depends on the futures represented in their training data. We identify a survivorship bias in driving world models: because the futures recorded in prevailing driving datasets almost always end safely, existing models often imagine benign outcomes even when a collision is imminent. We introduce a neutral world model (NWM) that learns both routine and safety-critical futures from a mixture of routine driving and real accident videos with a bounding-box-guided objective. The NWM more faithfully anticipates imminent collisions, while maintaining a low false collision rate and competitive generation quality in routine driving. We further use the model as an imagination engine for decision-making. Given multiple ego trajectories, the NWM predicts the future associated with each candidate, and a reward function evaluates these imagined outcomes before selecting an action. On challenging NAVSIM scenarios, this procedure selects the better trajectory more reliably than the baseline world model. Zero-shot experiments with real-world pedestrian dummy crossing data collected using an autonomous research vehicle further demonstrate transfer to unseen sensor observations. These results show that correcting survivorship bias enables world models to more faithfully reason about futures and support safety-critical decision-making in autonomous driving.
tldr: This paper identifies and addresses survivorship bias in driving world models by training a neutral world model on a mixture of routine and accident videos, enabling more faithful collision anticipation and improved decision-making in autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文识别并解决了驾驶世界模型中的幸存者偏差，通过混合常规和事故视频训练中性世界模型，使其能更准确地预测碰撞并改善自动驾驶决策。
summary_zh: 世界模型使自动驾驶车辆能够在执行候选动作之前预想其后果，但其可靠性取决于训练数据中所表征的未来情景。我们发现驾驶世界模型中存在一种生存者偏差：由于主流驾驶数据集中记录的未来情景几乎总是以安全收尾，现有模型即使在碰撞迫在眉睫时也往往预想出良性结果。我们提出了一种中性世界模型（NWM），该模型通过边界框引导的目标函数，从常规驾驶视频与真实事故视频的混合数据中学习常规未来情景与安全关键未来情景。NWM能够更准确地预判即将发生的碰撞，同时在常规驾驶中保持较低的误报碰撞率和具有竞争力的生成质量。我们进一步将该模型用作决策的想象力引擎。给定多条自车轨迹，NWM预测每条候选轨迹对应的未来情景，并由奖励函数在选定动作之前评估这些预想结果。在具有挑战性的NAVSIM场景中，该流程比基线世界模型更可靠地选出更优轨迹。使用自动驾驶研究车辆采集的真实行人假人穿越数据的零样本实验进一步验证了该模型对未见传感器观测的泛化能力。这些结果表明，修正生存者偏差使世界模型能够更准确地推理未来情景，并支持自动驾驶中的安全关键决策。

title: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. We introduce DexForesight, a framework that learns spatial foresight implicitly by injecting dynamics-aware world representations into the latent space of a dexterous policy. During training, DexForesight learns an action-conditioned spatial world model from offline scene depth, kinematic hand geometry, and demonstration trajectories. The world model predicts 3D hand-point motion and visual feature changes, capturing both articulated hand dynamics and scene changes under demonstrated actions, including the motion of fingers occluded from the cameras. We then freeze the world model and align policy queries with its predictive world queries, transferring the learned spatial dynamics into policy latents and using them to condition action generation. At deployment, only the policy is retained, operating on RGB observations, language, and robot state without depth input or explicit future prediction. On 11 DexJoCo simulation tasks, DexForesight improves the overall success rate of the base policy from 49.4% to 60.5%. On three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks, DexForesight achieves 58.3% success, compared with 50.0% for the strongest baseline.Project page https://dexforesight.github.io/
tldr: DexForesight implicitly learns spatial foresight by aligning a policy's latent space with an action-conditioned world model trained on offline scene depth and kinematic hand geometry, improving dexterous manipulation success across simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: DexForesight通过将策略的潜在空间与在离线场景深度和运动学手部几何上训练的动作条件世界模型对齐，隐式地学习空间预见能力，提高了仿真和真实机器人上的灵巧操作成功率。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作需要对周围场景和机器人手部具备丰富的空间前瞻能力。现有的世界-动作模型通常通过显式的未来预测来获取此类预测性知识。我们提出了DexForesight框架，该框架通过将动力学感知的世界表示注入灵巧策略的潜空间，以隐式方式学习空间前瞻能力。在训练阶段，DexForesight从离线场景深度、运动学手部几何和示教轨迹中学习一个以动作条件化的空间世界模型。该世界模型预测3D手部点运动及视觉特征变化，捕捉演示动作下的关节手部动力学和场景变化，包括被相机遮挡的手指运动。随后，我们冻结世界模型，并将策略查询与其预测性世界查询对齐，将学习到的空间动力学迁移到策略潜空间中，并以此调节动作生成。在部署阶段，仅保留策略，直接基于RGB观测、语言和机器人状态运行，无需深度输入或显式未来预测。在11项DexJoCo仿真任务中，DexForesight将基线策略的总体成功率从49.4%提升至60.5%。在三项真实机器人灵巧操作任务中，DexForesight达到了58.3%的成功率，而最强基线为50.0%。项目页面：https://dexforesight.github.io/

title: MOSU2: Long-range Navigation System with Multi-modal Scene Understanding
summary: Robots that travel long distances through public outdoor spaces must do more than avoid obstacles: they must remain on terrain suited to their mobility and decide when to proceed, yield, or detour around pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles, traffic signals, and temporary restrictions. These decisions are difficult because their correctness often depends on how a scene evolves, such as whether an approaching car is slowing or a cyclist will cross the robot's path. Vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret such cues, but they reason over images that lack metric geometry and motion. Supplying this evidence at every step is too slow for real-time navigation, and hand-crafted triggers cannot anticipate the open-ended variety of outdoor situations. We present MOSU2, a long-range navigation system with two-stage trajectory selection, in which first-stage contextual reasoning determines when additional evidence is needed and what to retrieve. Only when an interaction remains unresolved does the first stage trigger the second stage to retrieve geometric and dynamic information and align it with scene context to make navigation decisions. Building on MOSU, MOSU2 follows routes from GPS-based route planning and filters candidate trajectories through multi-modal traversability analysis before selecting a trajectory to move the robot. In real-world experiments spanning stop gestures, construction sites, crosswalks, and roads shared with vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians, MOSU2 raises mean navigation success from 61.8% to 94.2% and condition-detection accuracy from 72.2% to 91.4% over its single-image predecessor, at about 2.2 times its mean decision latency. Project website: https://jinggm.github.io/mosu2/
tldr: MOSU2 is a long-range navigation system that uses a two-stage trajectory selection approach, where first-stage contextual reasoning with VLMs triggers second-stage retrieval of geometric and dynamic information only when needed, improving navigation success and condition-detection accuracy in real-world outdoor experiments.
tldr_zh: MOSU2 是一种远程导航系统，采用两阶段轨迹选择方法，第一阶段使用 VLM 进行情境推理，仅在需要时触发第二阶段获取几何和动态信息，在真实世界室外实验中提高了导航成功率和条件检测准确率。
summary_zh: 在公共场所长距离行驶的机器人不仅要避开障碍物，还必须保持在适合其机动性的地形上，并决定何时前进、让行或绕行行人、自行车、车辆、交通信号灯及临时限制。这些决策颇具难度，因为其正确性往往取决于场景的动态演变，例如迎面驶来的汽车是否在减速，或骑车人是否会横穿机器人的路径。视觉语言模型（VLM）能够解读此类线索，但其推理所基于的图像缺乏度量几何和运动信息。在每一步都提供这些证据对于实时导航而言过于缓慢，而手工设计的触发条件无法预判室外场景中开放式的多样情形。我们提出MOSU2，一种采用两阶段轨迹选择的长距离导航系统，其中第一阶段的情境推理决定何时需要额外证据以及需要检索什么内容。仅当交互尚未解决时，第一阶段才触发第二阶段检索几何和动态信息，并将其与场景情境对齐以做出导航决策。MOSU2在MOSU的基础上，遵循基于GPS的路线规划，并在选择移动机器人的轨迹之前，通过多模态可通行性分析对候选轨迹进行筛选。在涵盖停车手势、施工现场、人行横道以及与车辆、自行车和行人共用的道路的真实世界实验中，MOSU2相比其单图像前身，将平均导航成功率从61.8%提升至94.2%，条件检测准确率从72.2%提升至91.4%，而平均决策延迟约为前者的2.2倍。项目网站：https://jinggm.github.io/mosu2/

title: CrossLiDAR: Controllable Multi-Sensor LiDAR Sequence Generation
summary: High-fidelity LiDAR simulation remains a bottleneck for scalable development and validation of autonomous systems. Existing generators can synthesize realistic scans, but they are typically constrained to a single sensor configuration, offer limited control over structure and geometry, and drift in long-horizon 4D generation. We present CrossLiDAR, a unified transformer-based framework capable of generating controllable and spatio-temporally consistent multi-sensor LiDAR sequences. Our approach leverages a rectified flow objective with a Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) backbone, within a compact latent space of range images. To support multiple LiDAR sensors, an Inter-sensor Module enables interaction across sensors, while a ControlNet-style branch provides structural conditioning (e.g., BEV priors or 3D bounding boxes). For modeling the temporal consistency, CrossLiDAR generates short $N$-frame sequences and extends them autoregressively to improve long-horizon coherence. Our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 29.56\% in JSD and 15.36\% in MMD evaluated on nuScenes and the Waymo Dataset. CrossLiDAR bridges the gap to modern autonomous-driving simulation by enabling calibration-consistent multi-sensor LiDAR rollouts over long horizons for controllable, scenario-based testing.
tldr: CrossLiDAR introduces a unified transformer-based framework for controllable, multi-sensor LiDAR sequence generation, using a rectified flow objective with Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer and ControlNet-style conditioning to achieve state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes and Waymo.
tldr_zh: CrossLiDAR 提出了一个统一的基于 Transformer 的框架，用于可控的多传感器 LiDAR 序列生成，利用 rectified flow 目标、多模态扩散 Transformer 和 ControlNet 风格的条件化，在 nuScenes 和 Waymo 数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 高保真LiDAR仿真仍是自主系统规模化开发与验证的瓶颈。现有生成器虽能合成逼真的扫描数据，但通常受限于单一传感器配置，对结构与几何的控制能力有限，且难以在长时间跨度的4D生成中保持一致性。我们提出CrossLiDAR，一个统一的基于Transformer的框架，能够生成可控且时空一致的多传感器LiDAR序列。该方法采用基于修正流目标与多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiT）骨干网络，在紧凑的距离图像潜空间中进行生成。为支持多种LiDAR传感器，跨传感器模块实现了传感器间的交互，同时ControlNet风格的分支提供结构条件注入（如BEV先验或3D边界框）。在时序一致性建模方面，CrossLiDAR生成短片段\(N\)帧序列，并通过自回归方式扩展，以增强长时程连贯性。我们的模型显著优于最先进基线，在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上JSD平均提升29.56\%，MMD平均提升15.36\%。CrossLiDAR通过实现标定一致的多传感器LiDAR长时程展开，填补了现代自动驾驶仿真中的空白，为可控、基于场景的测试提供了支撑。

title: From Festival Video to the Stage: A Sim-to-Real Ladder for Long-Horizon Expressive Whole-Body Dance on a Commercial Humanoid
summary: We present a pipeline for transferring Awa Odori, a traditional Japanese festival dance, from monocular video to a commercial Unitree G1 EDU humanoid. The pipeline combines human mesh recovery, kinematic retargeting, reinforcement learning for motion tracking in simulation, and onboard deployment via ONNX. Training ran on a single RTX 5070 GPU. An eleven-version deployment ladder evaluated on hardware examines three interventions. We detect and repair silent corruption of deployment artifacts, model state-estimator drift during training, and edit the reference motion to support stable execution and a controlled ending. The final policies achieved three consecutive rope-free completions of a 43-second routine, a 46-second performance with automatic handoff, and a continuous 9.7-minute rope-free performance composed from the captured motion. In a live handover, a single remote request let the robot start from and return to the manufacturer's walking controller on stage, with a measured torque-free window of 45-140 ms. We report the training dynamics and hardware outcomes and discuss failure boundaries involving compliant flooring and occlusion in monocular capture.
tldr: This paper presents a complete sim-to-real pipeline for transferring a traditional Japanese dance from monocular video to a commercial humanoid robot, addressing issues like artifact corruption, state-estimator drift, and reference motion editing, and achieving long-duration, rope-free hardware performances.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一条完整的从单目视频到商用人形机器人的仿真到现实迁移流水线，用于迁移传统日本舞蹈，解决了工件损坏、状态估计器漂移和参考运动编辑等问题，并在硬件上实现了长时间、无绳索的表演。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一套流水线，用于将日本传统节日舞蹈“阿波舞”从单目视频迁移至商用Unitree G1 EDU人形机器人。该流水线整合了人体网格恢复、运动学重定向、基于强化学习的仿真运动跟踪，以及通过ONNX实现的本机部署。训练在单张RTX 5070 GPU上完成。在硬件上评估的十一版部署阶梯检验了三项干预措施。我们检测并修复了部署工件的静默损坏，在训练过程中对状态估计器漂移进行了建模，并编辑了参考运动以支持稳定执行和控制性收尾。最终策略成功完成了连续三次无绳索的43秒套路表演、一次带自动交接的46秒演出，以及一次由采集动作拼接而成的连续9.7分钟无绳索表演。在一次现场交接中，单次远程请求使机器人能够从制造商自带的行走控制器启动并在舞台上返回该控制器，实测无扭矩窗口为45至140毫秒。我们报告了训练动态和硬件结果，并讨论了涉及柔性地板和单目采集遮挡的失败边界。

title: HARP-Bench: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Around Active Humans
summary: Recent robot manipulation benchmarks have enabled systematic evaluation of general-purpose robot policies across diverse objects, scenes, instructions, and embodiments. However, most existing benchmarks still assume that the robot is the only active agent and that task semantics are determined primarily by the instruction and object state. This assumption overlooks a common source of real-world variation: humans actively sharing the workspace. In such settings, humans may reveal an implicit goal, complete part of the task, temporarily change object availability, or constrain safe robot motion while working nearby. We introduce HARP-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation policies in workspaces shared with active humans. HARP-Bench treats human activity as part of the manipulation problem, rather than as background scene variation. It organizes human-present manipulation into four conditions: Cueing, Contribution, Interruption, and Co-presence. These conditions are instantiated through everyday manipulation tasks, including paired human-present variants for controlled comparison with standard manipulation. HARP-Bench also provides a demonstration-generation pipeline for dynamic human-present settings. We evaluate VLA models, imitation-learning methods, and heuristic policies on HARP-Bench. Human-present variations challenge current policies, and higher task success does not consistently improve safety. Quantitative failure analysis identifies manipulation and recovery as the dominant remaining challenges. Training with HARP-Bench demonstrations improves human-present performance in simulation. A real-world study on one task family shows improved performance under human contribution, but not interruption, providing initial evidence of the data's utility and identifying limits of transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/harp.
tldr: HARP-Bench introduces a benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation policies in workspaces shared with active humans, categorizing human-present manipulation into four conditions and showing that current VLA and IL policies struggle with safety and adaptability in these settings.
tldr_zh: HARP-Bench 提出了一个基准，用于评估在人类主动共享工作空间中的机器人操作策略，将人类在场操作分为四类条件，并表明当前的 VLA 和 IL 策略在这些场景中的安全性和适应性存在不足。
summary_zh: 近期关于机器人操作领域的基准测试，已经能够对通用型机器人策略在多样化物体、场景、指令及实体配置上的表现进行系统性评估。然而，大多数现有基准测试仍假设机器人是唯一的活动主体，且任务语义主要由指令和物体状态决定。这一假设忽视了现实世界中一个常见的变化来源：人类主动共享工作空间。在此类情境下，人类可能透露出隐含的目标、完成部分任务、临时改变物体的可获取性，或在附近工作时限制机器人的安全运动范围。为此，我们引入了HARP-Bench，这是一项专为评估在与活跃人类共享的工作空间中运行的机器人操作策略而设计的基准测试。HARP-Bench将人类活动视为操作问题的一部分，而非背景场景的变动。它将涉及人类在场的操作任务划分为四种情形：提示（Cueing）、贡献（Contribution）、打断（Interruption）和共存（Co-presence）。这些情形通过日常操作任务具体实现，并包含了配对的人类在场变体，以便与标准操作进行对照比较。HARP-Bench还提供了一套面向动态人类在场场景的演示生成流程。我们在HARP-Bench上评估了视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型、模仿学习方法及启发式策略的表现。人类在场的变体对当前策略构成了挑战，而更高的任务成功率并不总能转化为更好的安全性。定量失败分析指出，操作与恢复能力仍是主要的挑战所在。利用HARP-Bench演示数据进行训练，能够提升模拟环境中人类在场场景下的表现。针对一个任务族进行的真实世界研究表明，在人类贡献的情形下性能有所提升，但在打断情形下则未见改善，这初步证明了数据的实用性，同时也揭示了迁移的局限。相关代码已公开于 https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/harp。

title: Efficient VLA Inference via Retrieval-Based Speculation and Hardware Acceleration
summary:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to understand and execute complex instructions, but their autoregressive (AR) action generation introduces significant latency on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Speculative decoding can accelerate AR-based inference by parallelizing action generation and verification; however, existing approaches rely on costly draft models, which are inefficient on edge platforms.
  In this paper, we propose Zora, a hardware-software co-design framework for accelerating AR-based VLA inference. Specifically, Zora introduces a lightweight retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based draft model that exploits robotic dynamics without additional neural draft models. We further reduce batch verification overhead through a kinematics-guided action-acceptance strategy and a KV-cache-sharing attention mechanism. To address the retrieval overhead introduced by RAG-based drafting, we co-design dedicated hardware support, Zora core, to address the memory irregularity in RAG-based drafting. We evaluate Zora on four VLA models with the LIBERO benchmark. Zora retains comparable accuracy while achieving up to 3.4$\times$ speedup with software-only optimization and up to 7.6$\times$ speedup with hardware support over GPUs.
tldr: Zora is a hardware-software co-design framework that accelerates autoregressive VLA inference on edge robots via a retrieval-augmented draft model, kinematics-guided acceptance, KV-cache sharing, and dedicated hardware, achieving up to 7.6x speedup on LIBERO.
tldr_zh: Zora 是一个软硬件协同设计框架，通过检索增强草稿模型、运动学引导的接受策略、KV缓存共享和专用硬件来加速边缘机器人上的自回归VLA推理，在LIBERO上实现最高7.6倍加速。
summary_zh:
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使机器人能够理解并执行复杂指令，但其自回归（AR）动作生成在资源受限的机器人平台上引入了显著延迟。推测解码可通过并行化动作生成与验证来加速基于自回归的推理；然而，现有方法依赖成本高昂的草稿模型，在边缘平台上效率较低。

本文提出Zora，一种用于加速基于自回归的VLA推理的软硬件协同设计框架。具体而言，Zora引入了一种基于轻量级检索增强生成（RAG）的草稿模型，利用机器人动力学特性，无需额外的神经草稿模型。我们进一步通过运动学引导的动作接受策略和键值缓存共享注意力机制，降低了批量验证的开销。为解决RAG式草稿生成引入的检索开销，我们协同设计了专用硬件支持——Zora核心，以应对RAG式草稿生成中的内存不规则性问题。我们基于LIBERO基准在四种VLA模型上对Zora进行了评估。Zora在保持相当精度的同时，在仅软件优化下实现了最高3.4倍的加速，在硬件支持下相比GPU实现了最高7.6倍的加速。

title: Control-Aware Command Generation for Asynchronous Control and Action Inference with Vision-Based Policies towards Fast Execution
summary: Vision-based control policies, including vision-language-action models, have enabled robots to perform increasingly complex tasks. However, their execution speed is often limited by the high computational cost of action inference. In this work, we investigate what can be achieved at the control level without modifying the underlying policy learning process. We introduce an asynchronous inference and control framework that enables fast task execution while maintaining smooth and stable robot motions. By formulating the generation of continuous target positions from discontinuous model predictions as a tracking control problem, our method makes asynchronous inference practical for real robots. We further accelerate execution through adaptive action skipping based on the variance of predicted positions. Experiments with Action Chunking Transformer and OpenVLA-OFT on a bimanual robot demonstrate substantial speedups while preserving high task success rates.
tldr: The paper introduces an asynchronous control and action inference framework for vision-based robot policies, using tracking control to generate continuous targets from discontinuous predictions and adaptive action skipping to speed up execution without modifying the policy learning process. It demonstrates substantial speedups on a bimanual robot with ACT and OpenVLA-OFT while maintaining task success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于基于视觉的机器人策略的异步控制和动作推理框架，通过跟踪控制生成连续目标位置并采用自适应动作跳过加速执行，无需修改策略学习过程，并在双机械臂上验证了显著加速和任务成功率保持。
summary_zh: 基于视觉的控制策略，包括视觉-语言-动作模型，已经使机器人能够执行日益复杂的任务。然而，其执行速度往往受到动作推理高计算成本的限制。在本研究中，我们探讨了在不修改底层策略学习过程的情况下，在控制层面能够实现何种改进。我们引入了一种异步推理与控制框架，该框架能够在实现快速任务执行的同时，保持机器人运动的平滑与稳定。通过将不连续的模型预测转换为连续目标位置的生成问题，并将其建模为跟踪控制问题，我们的方法使异步推理在实际机器人上得以切实应用。我们进一步基于预测位置的方差采用自适应动作跳过机制，以加速执行过程。在双臂机器人上使用动作分块变换器（Action Chunking Transformer）和OpenVLA-OFT进行的实验表明，该方法在显著提升速度的同时保持了较高的任务成功率。

title: ObjectWorld: Scaling Object-Centric World Models with A Large-Scale 3D Full-Object Flow Dataset
summary: Generative world modeling from large-scale visual data offers a promising path toward scalable robot manipulation. This calls for an intermediate representation that can be supervised at scale and remains actionable for downstream control. We propose 3D full-object flow, an object-centric motion representation that assigns dense 3D trajectories to points across the complete surface of a target object, including its occluded regions. By extending visible-surface object flow to the full object geometry, this representation makes complete object motion explicit and applies uniformly to both rigid and deformable objects. To realize the potential of this representation at scale, we introduce a 1210-hour full-object flow dataset that addresses the scarcity of large-scale supervision for complete 3D object motion. The dataset integrates diverse real-world videos and physical simulations, with a scalable annotation pipeline for recovering full-object motion from real-world observations and quality metrics for systematically assessing annotation quality. We then train a world model that takes an image and a task description as input and predicts dense full-object flow over the reconstructed object geometry. Experiments show reliable annotation quality, data-scalable flow prediction, and effective downstream manipulation across novel scenes and robot embodiments. Project website with additional results and videos: https://nus-lins-lab.github.io/ObjectWorld/.
tldr: ObjectWorld proposes 3D full-object flow as an object-centric motion representation and introduces a large-scale 1210-hour dataset to train world models that predict dense full-object flow from images and task descriptions, enabling scalable robot manipulation across novel scenes and embodiments.
tldr_zh: ObjectWorld 提出三维全物体流作为物体中心的运动表示，并构建了 1210 小时的大规模数据集，用于训练世界模型，使其能从图像和任务描述中预测稠密全物体流，从而支持新颖场景和机器人形态下的可扩展操作。
summary_zh: 生成世界模型从大规模视觉数据中为可扩展的机器人操作提供了一条很有前景的路径。这需要一种中间表示，既能在大规模数据上进行监督学习，又能对下游控制保持可操作性。我们提出了三维全物体流（3D full-object flow），这是一种以物体为中心的运动表示，为目标物体完整表面上的点赋予密集的三维轨迹，包括其被遮挡的区域。通过将可见表面物体流扩展到完整的物体几何结构，该表示使完整的物体运动变得明确，并统一适用于刚体和可变形物体。为了在大规模上实现该表示的潜力，我们引入了一个1210小时的全物体流数据集，以解决完整三维物体运动的大规模监督数据稀缺的问题。该数据集整合了多样化的真实世界视频和物理仿真，并配备了一个可扩展的标注流程，用于从真实世界观测中恢复完整的物体运动，以及用于系统评估标注质量的质量指标。随后，我们训练了一个世界模型，该模型以图像和任务描述为输入，并在重建的物体几何结构上预测密集的全物体流。实验表明，该模型在标注质量上可靠，流预测可随数据规模扩展，并且在新场景和不同机器人形态下均能实现有效的下游操作。包含更多结果和视频的项目网站：https://nus-lins-lab.github.io/ObjectWorld/。

title: BAT-WAM: Bridging Action and Touch in World-Action Models for Dexterous Hands
summary: Dexterous manipulation with world action models (WAMs) relies on hand configuration and contact information, yet joint-state and whole-hand tactile observations may be partially or entirely missing. RGB images provide scene context and hand-object geometry but are insufficient to reliably recover these missing modalities. We further observe a correlation between hand state and tactile information. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BAT-WAM, a framework that bridges visual, joint-state, and tactile representations for WAMs. BAT-WAM learns separate codebooks and decoders for the tactile and action streams. An RGB-conditioned continuous latent bridge connects the two streams for bidirectional learning, while visual information serves as continuous context. Under the HTBench evaluation protocol, BAT-WAM reduces the root mean squared error (RMSE) of tactile reconstruction by 34.73% under fully masked conditions and 38.84% under partially masked conditions, relative to an image-conditioned HandTouch checkpoint. For future tactile prediction conditioned on target-time RGB and historical actions, it reduces mean RMSE by 85.56% relative to OpenWAM with HandTouch. Real-robot experiments further show that BAT-WAM consistently outperforms related WAM baselines in dexterous manipulation. Generalization experiments on unseen objects and scenes also demonstrate substantial improvements over baseline models. These findings support joint modeling of visual context, hand state, and touch as a representation approach for multimodal WAMs.
tldr: BAT-WAM introduces a framework that bridges visual, joint-state, and tactile representations in world action models, improving tactile reconstruction and future prediction for dexterous manipulation, with real-robot validation.
tldr_zh: BAT-WAM 提出了一种在世界动作模型中桥接视觉、关节状态和触觉表示的框架，改善了灵巧操作的触觉重建和未来预测，并通过真实机器人实验验证。
summary_zh: 基于世界动作模型（WAMs）的灵巧操作依赖于手部构型与接触信息，然而关节状态和全手触觉观测可能部分或完全缺失。RGB图像提供了场景上下文及手-物几何信息，但不足以可靠地恢复这些缺失模态。我们进一步观察到手部状态与触觉信息之间存在相关性。受此观察启发，我们提出BAT-WAM，一个为WAMs桥接视觉、关节状态与触觉表示的框架。BAT-WAM为触觉流和动作流分别学习独立的码本与解码器。一个以RGB为条件的连续潜变量桥接网络连接两条流以实现双向学习，同时视觉信息作为连续上下文。在HTBench评估协议下，与以图像为条件的HandTouch检查点相比，BAT-WAM在全掩蔽条件下将触觉重建的均方根误差（RMSE）降低了34.73%，在部分掩蔽条件下降低了38.84%。对于以目标时刻RGB和历史动作条件化的未来触觉预测，其平均RMSE相对于OpenWAM结合HandTouch降低了85.56%。真实机器人实验进一步表明，BAT-WAM在灵巧操作中始终优于相关的WAM基线模型。针对未见物体和场景的泛化实验也显示出相对于基线模型的显著改进。这些发现支持将视觉上下文、手部状态与触觉进行联合建模，作为多模态WAMs的一种表示方法。

title: From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Training vision-language-action (VLA) models to follow gameplay instructions across diverse games is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. We introduce a framework that automatically generates game environments and expert demonstrations. An LLM-powered agent uses game-building tools to construct executable environments and tasks targeting specified skills. Programmatic experts then use privileged simulator state to generate aligned instructions, rendered observations, and keyboard and mouse actions. We train our game policy, Script2Play, by post-training a 4B vision-language model with behavior cloning on 150.3 hours of synthetic Minecraft and Roblox gameplay, without human gameplay demonstrations or reinforcement learning. Evaluation on multiple public game benchmarks demonstrates that Script2Play follows gameplay instructions effectively and generalizes across game engines, highlighting the effectiveness of targeted synthetic supervision.
tldr: This paper introduces a framework that automatically generates game environments and expert demonstrations to train a vision-language-action model, Script2Play, for gameplay instruction following, demonstrating generalization across game engines without human data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个自动生成游戏环境和专家演示的框架，用于训练视觉-语言-动作模型Script2Play，使其能遵循游戏指令并跨游戏引擎泛化，无需人工数据。
summary_zh: 训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在多样化游戏中遵循游戏指令的能力，受限于收集示范数据的成本。我们提出了一种框架，能够自动生成游戏环境和专家示范。一个由大语言模型驱动的智能体利用游戏构建工具，针对指定技能构建可执行的环境和任务。随后，程序化专家利用特权模拟器状态生成对齐的指令、渲染观测以及键盘和鼠标操作。我们通过在后训练阶段对40亿参数的视觉-语言模型进行行为克隆，使用了150.3小时的合成《我的世界》和《罗布乐思》游戏数据，训练了我们的游戏策略模型Script2Play，全程无需人类游戏示范或强化学习。在多个公开游戏基准上的评估表明，Script2Play能够有效遵循游戏指令，并跨游戏引擎实现泛化，凸显了针对性合成监督的有效性。

title: Review the Episodes, Refine the Lessons: Simple Memory Evolution for Embodied Agents
summary: Recent studies of embodied agents based on frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) develop harness engineering around the MLLM, such as harnesses with post-trained policies and recursive self-improvement loops. Yet whether these additions exceed the native capability of the MLLM remains unexplored. We introduce SimplEvo to explore how far an MLLM can improve under direct control when it retains its execution experience in self-written text memories. It requires no weight updates, post-trained policies, or privileged information. The MLLM writes a coordinate-free task memory once from a single demonstration. Under a strict train-test protocol, it then creates a bounded working memory on training episodes only and refines it after each episode with lessons on procedure, completion, and recovery. Both memories stay fixed at test time. On EBench, SimplEvo lifts the success rate (SR) of GPT-6-Astra under direct control from 46.7% to 81.7%, and tops the RoboDojo leaderboard with 69.63% SR and a score of 75.32. Compared with memories that also store past visual frames, SimplEvo reaches a similar SR with text memory alone while using fewer tokens. With its memories fixed, SimplEvo also generalizes to unseen layouts and randomized scene configurations. Moreover, the working memory transfers across models: written by GPT-6-Astra, it can be reused as is by weaker MLLMs and improve their performance without any adaptation of their own.
tldr: This paper introduces SimplEvo, a memory-based method that improves the success rate of multimodal large language models on embodied agent tasks by writing and iteratively refining text-only task memories from demonstrations and training episodes, without weight updates or privileged information.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SimplEvo，一种基于记忆的方法，通过从演示和训练情节中编写并迭代优化纯文本任务记忆，在无需权重更新或特权信息的情况下，提高了多模态大语言模型在具身智能任务上的成功率。
summary_zh: 近期基于前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的具身智能体研究，围绕MLLM开发了配套的工程框架，例如集成后训练策略及递归自我改进循环的框架。然而，这些额外机制是否超越了MLLM自身的原生能力，仍未得到充分探究。我们提出SimplEvo，旨在探索在直接控制下，MLLM仅凭其以自写文本记忆保留执行经验，能够实现多大的性能提升。该方法无需权重更新、后训练策略或特权信息。MLLM仅依据一次示范，即撰写一份与坐标无关的任务记忆。在严格的训练-测试协议下，它仅在训练片段上构建有界的工作记忆，并在每个片段结束后，依据关于流程、完成情况及恢复的教训对其进行优化。两种记忆在测试阶段均保持不变。在EBench基准上，SimplEvo将GPT-6-Astra在直接控制下的成功率（SR）从46.7%提升至81.7%，并以69.63%的SR和75.32的得分位居RoboDojo排行榜首位。与同时存储过往视觉帧的记忆相比，SimplEvo仅凭文本记忆即可达到相近的SR，且所用令牌更少。在记忆固定不变的情况下，SimplEvo还能泛化至未见过的布局及随机化场景配置。此外，该工作记忆具有跨模型迁移性：由GPT-6-Astra生成的记忆，可被较弱的MLLM直接复用，并在无需自身任何适配的情况下提升其性能。

title: Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration
summary: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon exploration.We present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future revisits.Upon returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task context.FLAVOR achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.
tldr: FLAVOR introduces a hierarchical spatio-temporal map representation for UAV exploration, using robot-centric local dense maps plus compact global observation and task context (LiDAR keyframes, pending frontiers, sparse topological graph) to keep memory bounded while achieving faster exploration and drastically reduced memory footprint in large-scale 3D tasks.
tldr_zh: FLAVOR 提出了一种用于无人机探索的层次化时空地图表示，通过机器人中心局部稠密地图和紧凑的全局观测与任务上下文（LiDAR 关键帧、待处理边界、稀疏拓扑图）在保持记忆受限的同时实现更快的探索和大幅降低的存储占用。
summary_zh: 自主无人机勘探越来越多地用于在无法进入或受灾环境中进行大规模测量和检查，而这类环境中机载存储和计算资源往往受到严重限制。现有的大多数无人机勘探系统为运动规划和勘探决策维护全局可查询的几何地图表示，导致内存消耗和空间查询成本随勘探面积增加而增长。以机器人为中心的局部地图限制了稠密地图的内存和计算，但丢弃了长时间勘探所需的全局任务上下文。我们提出了FLAVOR，一种分层时空框架，将稠密度量几何限制在以机器人为中心的局部地图中，同时保留紧凑的全局观测和任务上下文。在观测层面，轻量级LiDAR关键帧可见性记录保留了用于前沿推理的逐射线证据。在任务层面，超出局部地图范围未解决的前沿被保留为与里程计锚点关联的紧凑待处理任务。稀疏拓扑图通过这些锚点经由保留路径连接，以支持未来重访。当返回任务区域时，FLAVOR从观测中重建前沿和勘探视点，同时拓扑路径在执行前被实例化并针对当前局部地图进行验证。随着勘探范围扩展，稠密地图容量保持固定，与勘探相关的内存增长仅限于紧凑的观测和任务上下文。与完成所有三个仿真场景的最佳基线相比，FLAVOR实现了31.98-41.88%的勘探时间缩短，以及94-99%的地图内存占用减少。在实际部署中，相较于显式点云ikd-tree，其在森林环境中将内存占用减少92.67%，在建筑工地减少62.42%，同时在受限机载资源下保持了长期任务连续性。

title: Off-Policy RL with Online Inference Tuning: My Solution to the CoRL 2026 RoboEval Challenge
summary: The CoRL 2026 RoboEval challenge has eight bimanual tasks, and it ranks a policy not only on whether it succeeds but on how: every stage of the task, done safely, efficiently and with both arms in coordination, scored against human demonstrations. My solution has two parts. The generic part, carried over from my LeHome challenge solution, is off-policy RL on a $π_{0.5}$-based policy that is also its own value function. It is trained with AWR and RECAP on advantages of the exact official score, in a loop where every rollout is at the same time a Thompson-sampling trial of about 20 inference parameters. Out of the box, it took the policy to 0.85 RDS on held-out seeds in two days (and it was still very far from convergence). The competition-specific part adds data that local exploration cannot find: generated demonstrations that reach the full reward, and recovery episodes that start from the policy's own failures. The submitted policy reaches 0.990 RDS on held-out seeds and 0.987 on the official seeds.
tldr: This paper presents an off-policy RL approach for bimanual manipulation tasks in the CoRL 2026 RoboEval challenge, combining AWR/RECAP training on a pi_0.5-based policy with generated demonstrations and recovery episodes to achieve high RDS scores.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于CoRL 2026 RoboEval挑战中双臂操作任务的离策略强化学习方法，结合基于pi_0.5策略的AWR/RECAP训练以及生成的演示和恢复片段，实现了高RDS分数。
summary_zh: CoRL 2026 RoboEval挑战赛包含八个双臂任务，其对策略的排名不仅依据任务是否成功，更关注完成方式：任务的每个阶段均需安全、高效地完成，且双臂协调配合，并与人类示范进行评分对比。我的解决方案分为两部分。通用部分沿用自我在LeHome挑战赛中的解决方案，即基于$π_{0.5}$的策略进行离线策略强化学习，该策略同时充当其自身的价值函数。训练采用AWR与RECAP方法，以官方评分的精确优势值为目标，在循环中每次 rollout 同时是对约20个推理参数的汤普森采样试验。开箱即用情况下，该方案在两天内使策略在预留种子上达到0.85 RDS（且远未收敛）。针对比赛特定部分，我补充了局部探索无法获取的数据：可达到完全奖励的生成示范，以及从策略自身失败状态出发的恢复片段。最终提交的策略在预留种子上达到0.990 RDS，在官方种子上达到0.987 RDS。

title: When Coding Agents Get Arms: Safety Risks Across the Digital-Physical Boundary
summary: Advances in spatial understanding have enabled frontier models to power coding agents that control a real robot arm zero-shot and end-to-end, without task-specific demonstrations or retraining. This brings two new safety challenges. First, the extensive knowledge of frontier models lets these agents perform tasks that earlier VLA and WAM paradigms could not, opening the door to new forms of capability misuse. Second, coding agents can access digital resources such as web pages and emails. Threats in these resources, such as indirect prompt injection, can carry over into the physical world when the agent controls a robot. We therefore introduce ArmedAgent, the first systematic benchmark to evaluate both risks for coding agents performing zero-shot robot control. It covers robustness, malicious use, and indirect injection across 36 tasks in 5 scenarios, evaluated in simulation and validated on a physical robot arm. A distinctive portion of the tasks target harmful behaviors that earlier VLA paradigms could not perform. Testing several frontier models, including GPT-6-Astra, under widely used agent frameworks, we find substantial safety risks in current systems.
tldr: This paper introduces ArmedAgent, the first benchmark to evaluate safety risks when large language model-based coding agents control a real robot arm zero-shot, covering robustness, malicious use, and indirect prompt injection across 36 tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 ArmedAgent，这是首个评估基于大语言模型的编码代理零样本控制真实机器人手臂时的安全风险的基准，涵盖鲁棒性、恶意使用和间接提示注入等 36 个任务。
summary_zh: 空间理解的进步使前沿模型能够驱动编码智能体，以零样本和端到端的方式控制真实机器人手臂，无需特定任务的演示或重新训练。这带来了两个新的安全挑战。首先，前沿模型广泛的知识使这些智能体能够执行早期VLA和WAM范式无法完成的任务，为新型能力滥用打开了大门。其次，编码智能体可以访问网页和电子邮件等数字资源。这些资源中的威胁，如间接提示注入，在智能体控制机器人时可能延伸到物理世界。因此，我们引入了ArmedAgent，这是第一个系统性基准，用于评估编码智能体执行零样本机器人控制时的两种风险。它涵盖了5个场景中36个任务的鲁棒性、恶意使用和间接注入，在模拟中评估并在物理机器人手臂上验证。任务中的独特部分针对的是早期VLA范式无法执行的有害行为。我们测试了包括GPT-6-Astra在内的多个前沿模型，在广泛使用的智能体框架下，发现当前系统存在重大安全风险。

title: DeepSoMo: Deformable Object Motion Estimation under Proprioceptive Partial Observability via Predictive Latent Dynamics
summary: Estimating the motion of deformable bodies in soft robotics from proprioceptive sensing is challenging due to partial observability, as internal observations provide only indirect access to global motion, contact, and shape evolution. In such settings, instantaneous observations are insufficient, and accurate estimation requires temporally consistent latent representations. This paper studies deformable motion estimation under proprioceptive partial observability from a latent dynamics perspective. We argue that a key requirement for long-horizon estimation is latent temporal consistency, where latent states remain predictive of future observations. To this end, we present DeepSoMo, a learning-based framework that enforces predictive structure in latent dynamics through a self-supervised latent prediction constraint. We evaluate the approach in a canonical deformable dynamics setting using high-fidelity finite-element simulation as a controlled source of ground truth. Results demonstrate consistent improvements in trajectory estimation, orientation recovery, shape reconstruction, and contact inference over architecture-matched recurrent baselines.
tldr: DeepSoMo introduces a self-supervised latent prediction constraint to learn temporally consistent latent dynamics, improving deformable object motion estimation and contact inference from proprioceptive sensing in soft robotics.
tldr_zh: DeepSoMo 通过自监督潜在预测约束来学习时间一致的潜在动力学，从而提高了软体机器人中基于本体感觉的可变形物体运动估计和接触推断。
summary_zh: 摘要：在软体机器人中，基于本体感觉传感估计可变形体的运动因部分可观测性而具有挑战性，因为内部观测仅能提供对全局运动、接触及形状演化的间接访问。在此类情境下，瞬时观测不足以支撑准确估计，需要时间上一致的潜在表示。本文从潜在动力学视角研究本体感觉部分可观测条件下的可变形运动估计。我们主张，长时程估计的关键要求在于潜在时间一致性，即潜在状态需保持对未来观测的预测能力。为此，我们提出DeepSoMo，一种基于学习的框架，通过自监督潜在预测约束在潜在动力学中强化预测结构。我们在典型可变形动力学环境中，利用高保真有限元模拟作为受控的真实基准进行评估。结果表明，在与架构匹配的递归基线方法相比，该方法在轨迹估计、姿态恢复、形状重建及接触推断方面均取得了一致的性能提升。

title: Large-Scale Hierarchical Decision-Making in Robot Control via ADMM
summary: Sparse hierarchical nonlinear programming (SH-NLP) based on the $\ell_0$-norm provides a powerful framework for integrated, efficient hierarchical decision-making in robot kinematic control, for example in the presence of a large set of possible end-effector candidate locations. While Sequential Sparse Hierarchical Quadratic Programming (S-SHQP) with interior-point method based SHQP sub-problem solvers exploit the hierarchical, sparse structure of such problems, they are less amenable to effective warm-starting between subsequent, coherent control steps. In this work, we formulate an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) to efficiently solve related SHQP sub-problems. We introduce efficient substitutions for auxiliary variables representing $\ell_0$-norm surrogates. The solver efficiently handles separable decision functions by evaluating linear algebra expressions in the appropriate order. Results in large-scale kinematic and dynamic control show reduced computation times of up to 23.5% compared with a structure-exploiting interior-point method in low- to moderate-accuracy regimes. Furthermore, hierarchical decision-making is extended to whole-body dynamic control for humanoid walking, where the need for high-accuracy solutions is highlighted.
tldr: This paper proposes an ADMM-based solver for sparse hierarchical nonlinear programming in robot control, achieving faster computation times than interior-point methods and extending hierarchical decision-making to whole-body humanoid walking control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于ADMM的求解器，用于机器人控制中的稀疏分层非线性规划，相较于内点法在计算时间上有所提升，并将分层决策扩展到仿人机器人全身行走控制。
summary_zh: 基于$\ell_0$范数的稀疏层次非线性规划（SH-NLP）为机器人运动学控制中的集成、高效层次决策提供了强大框架，例如在存在大量末端执行器候选位置的情况下。尽管采用内点法求解SHQP子问题的顺序稀疏层次二次规划（S-SHQP）能够利用此类问题的层次性和稀疏结构，但其在后续连贯控制步骤之间难以实现有效的热启动。本文提出了一种基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的求解器，用于高效求解相关的SHQP子问题。我们为表示$\ell_0$范数替代的辅助变量引入了高效的替换策略。该求解器通过按适当顺序评估线性代数表达式，高效处理可分离的决策函数。在大规模运动学与动力学控制中的结果表明，在低至中等精度区间内，与利用结构的内点法相比，计算时间最多可减少23.5%。此外，层次决策被扩展到仿人行走的全身动力学控制中，并凸显了高精度求解的必要性。

title: RoboMoCap: A Large-Scale Whole-Body Motion Capture Dataset with Egocentric Vision for Robot Learning
summary: Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation to navigate complex environments and perform everyday tasks. Learning such behaviours from human demonstrations requires accurate whole-body motion paired with egocentric vision, particularly for lower-body movements and foot placements that are frequently invisible from a first-person perspective. However, existing egocentric datasets often lack high-fidelity optical motion capture or systematic coverage of diverse loco-manipulation behaviours. To address this gap, we introduce RoboMoCap, a large-scale multimodal dataset combining egocentric vision with marker-based optical motion capture, specifically designed for locomotion-centric humanoid learning. RoboMoCap comprises over 200 hours of recordings from 14 participants, featuring six head-mounted cameras, wrist-mounted visual and inertial sensing, and optical full-body motion capture at 120 Hz. The dataset systematically covers diverse locomotion primitives, dynamic whole-body movements, and loco-manipulation tasks, including variable-speed walking, turning, constrained navigation, terrain traversal, object transportation, and manipulation during locomotion. It provides temporally aligned multimodal observations and metric whole-body motion representations, enabling the study of human movement beyond directly observable body regions. We systematically evaluate existing methods on three benchmark tasks: egocentric full-body motion reconstruction, foot contact and placement estimation, and human-to-humanoid motion retargeting. By pairing egocentric vision with high-fidelity human motion across diverse locomotion and interaction scenarios, RoboMoCap provides a foundation for egocentric motion understanding and humanoid learning from human demonstrations.
tldr: RoboMoCap is a large-scale egocentric vision and optical motion capture dataset for locomotion-centric humanoid robot learning, providing over 200 hours of multimodal data across diverse loco-manipulation tasks and benchmarks for motion reconstruction, foot contact estimation, and human-to-humanoid retargeting.
tldr_zh: RoboMoCap 是一个面向运动中心的人形机器人学习的大规模自我中心视觉与光学动作捕捉数据集，提供超过200小时的多模态数据，涵盖多种运动-操作任务，并用于动作重建、足部接触估计和人到人形重定向等基准测试。
summary_zh: 人形机器人必须协调运动与操作能力，才能在复杂环境中导航并执行日常任务。从人类示范中学习此类行为，需要将精确的全身动作与以自我为中心的视觉相结合，尤其是在第一人称视角下经常不可见的下半身动作和足部落点。然而，现有的第一视角数据集往往缺乏高保真光学动作捕捉，或缺乏对多样化运动-操作行为的系统性覆盖。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了RoboMoCap，这是一个大规模多模态数据集，将第一视角视觉与基于标记的光学动作捕捉相结合，专门面向以运动为核心的人形机器人学习而设计。RoboMoCap包含来自14名参与者的超过200小时记录，配备六个头戴式摄像头、腕戴式视觉和惯性传感设备，以及120 Hz的光学全身动作捕捉系统。该数据集系统性地覆盖了多样化的运动基元、动态全身动作以及运动中的操作任务，包括变速行走、转向、受限环境导航、地形穿越、物体搬运以及运动过程中的操作。它提供时间对齐的多模态观测数据和公制全身动作表示，使得研究超出直接可见身体区域的人体运动成为可能。我们在三个基准任务上系统评估了现有方法：第一视角全身动作重建、足部接触与落点估计，以及人形到人形机器人的动作重定向。通过将第一视角视觉与多样化运动和交互场景下的高保真人体动作相结合，RoboMoCap为第一视角动作理解以及从人类示范中学习人形机器人行为奠定了基础。

title: Explicitly capturing demonstrator multi-modality for distillation into diffusion policies
summary: The diversity of a distilled diffusion policy's outputs matters beyond how it impacts the policy's success rate. In particular, downstream applications like test-time search and policy improvement require exploration. Thus, we want to distill multi-modal demonstrators into diffusion policies which reproduce their conditional action distributions. Standard data collection for behavior cloning applies a sliding window to demonstration episodes, which pairs unique observation histories with actions. These datasets can be fit by a policy that is either multi-modal, or unimodal with high Lipschitz constant to capture a diversity of actions seen at nearby observation samples. Prior work finds that diffusion policies trained on sparse data learn the latter, memorizing one action per observation. We adapt vine sampling to behavior cloning data collection to resolve this ambiguity: at some states the demonstrator visits, query it $k$ times from exactly the same observation. On a synthetic task, we study how the number of actions per observation, $k$, affects the learned policy, and find that larger $k$ yields a policy that better matches the demonstrator's conditional distribution, including its multi-modality and diversity. On a 2D truck unloading task, vine sampling likewise leads to a policy closer to the demonstrator and substantially improves both best-of-$N$ and expert iteration performance.
tldr: This paper introduces vine sampling for behavior cloning data collection to explicitly capture multi-modal demonstrator actions, improving the fidelity of distilled diffusion policies to the demonstrator's conditional action distribution and enhancing downstream tasks like best-of-N and expert iteration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出在行为克隆数据采集中使用vine sampling，以显式捕获演示者的多模态动作，从而提高蒸馏扩散策略对条件动作分布的拟合度，并改善如best-of-N和专家迭代等下游任务。
summary_zh: 扩散蒸馏策略输出的多样性不仅影响策略的成功率，在测试时搜索和策略改进等下游应用中，探索能力同样至关重要。因此，我们希望将多模态演示者蒸馏为扩散策略，使其能够复现条件动作分布。行为克隆的标准数据收集方法是对演示片段应用滑动窗口，将独特的观测历史与动作配对。这些数据集可以通过多模态策略或具有高Lipschitz常数的单模态策略来拟合，以捕捉邻近观测样本中出现的动作多样性。先前的研究发现，在稀疏数据上训练的扩散策略倾向于学习后者，即对每个观测记忆单一动作。我们采用vine抽样方法改进行为克隆的数据收集，以解决这一歧义：在演示者访问的某些状态，从完全相同的观测点查询其$k$次。在合成任务上，我们研究了每个观测对应的动作数量$k$如何影响学习到的策略，发现较大的$k$能够产生更好地匹配演示者条件分布（包括其多模态性和多样性）的策略。在二维卡车卸载任务中，vine抽样同样使得策略更接近演示者，并显著提升了best-of-$N$和专家迭代的性能。

title: BRACE: Belief-guided Residual Adaptive Control for Safe Navigation under Unknown Disturbances
summary: Disturbances encountered during autonomous navigation generally vary across space, often discontinuously, as obstacles redirect wind and changing terrain alters traction. Tracking controllers typically assume sufficient control authority to mitigate disturbances and maintain safety; the regime where this assumption fails remains underexplored. We present Belief-guided Residual Adaptive Control (BRACE), a hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework for reach-avoid navigation under unknown, bounded, spatially varying disturbances. BRACE infers a disturbance belief from model prediction errors and uses that to condition a high-level policy that adapts the reference trajectory. The policy combines a nominal and a belief-guided residual term, trained jointly with a likelihood-ratio advantage reweighting heuristic. We evaluate BRACE in three simulated quadcopter environments with abruptly switching wind fields, and validate it on Crazyflie hardware with fan-generated disturbances. Across these settings, BRACE improves reach-avoid performance over model predictive control and RL baselines.
tldr: BRACE is a hierarchical RL framework that infers disturbance beliefs from prediction errors and adapts reference trajectories for safe reach-avoid navigation under unknown spatial disturbances, validated in simulation and on Crazyflie hardware.
tldr_zh: BRACE是一种分层强化学习框架，通过从预测误差中推断扰动信念并调整参考轨迹，在未知空间扰动下实现安全到达-避免导航，并在仿真和Crazyflie硬件上得到验证。
summary_zh: 自主导航过程中遇到的扰动通常在空间上变化，且往往不连续，因为障碍物会改变风向，而地形的变化会影响牵引力。跟踪控制器通常假设具有足够的控制权限来抑制扰动并确保安全性；当这一假设不成立时，相关工况尚未得到充分研究。我们提出了一种基于信念的残差自适应控制方法（Belief-guided Residual Adaptive Control, BRACE），这是一种分层强化学习框架，用于在未知、有界、空间变化的扰动下实现到达-回避导航。BRACE从模型预测误差中推断扰动信念，并利用该信念调节高层策略，以自适应调整参考轨迹。该策略结合了名义项和信念引导的残差项，并通过似然比优势重加权启发式方法进行联合训练。我们在三个具有突变风场的模拟四旋翼环境中评估了BRACE，并在Crazyflie硬件上利用风扇产生的扰动进行了验证。在这些设置下，BRACE相较于模型预测控制和强化学习基线，在到达-回避性能上均有所提升。

title: MoT3DVG: A Benchmark for Outdoor 3D Visual Grounding with Motion-Aware Descriptions and Temporal Cues
summary: 3D visual grounding (3DVG) localizes language-referred objects in 3D scenes, with broad applicability in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, existing 3DVG research focuses on static indoor objects, limiting its use in dynamic outdoor autonomous driving. Motion descriptions, which capture the temporal dynamics of moving objects, offer a promising way to address this challenge. We therefore introduce MoT3DVG, a large-scale dataset for dynamic-aware outdoor 3DVG with temporally evolving motion descriptions. It contains 850 scenarios with 31,128 frames from nuScenes dataset, and provides 144,568 language prompts with motion-aware descriptions for dynamic objects across time. We further propose DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG. In addition to the standard modality-specific encoders, DynaVG introduces a Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding (SLIDE) module before the language-point cloud alignment. SLIDE models both local motion cues and global temporal context via short-term window encoding and long-term window shifting. Extensive experiments demonstrate its state-of-the-art performance on MoT3DVG, validating the effectiveness of motion-aware encoding. Our work reveals open challenges and promising directions for future research in outdoor 3DVG.
tldr: Introduces MoT3DVG, a large-scale benchmark for outdoor 3D visual grounding with motion-aware descriptions using nuScenes data, and proposes DynaVG, a framework with a Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding module to leverage temporal cues for state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 提出了MoT3DVG，一个基于nuScenes的大规模户外3D视觉定位基准，包含运动感知描述，并提出了DynaVG框架，通过短-长集成动态编码模块利用时间线索取得最佳性能。
summary_zh: 三维视觉定位（3DVG）旨在三维场景中定位语言所指对象，在室内和室外环境中具有广泛的应用前景。然而，现有三维视觉定位研究主要聚焦于静态室内对象，限制了其在动态室外自动驾驶场景中的使用。运动描述能够捕捉运动对象的时间动态特征，为应对这一挑战提供了有前景的解决方案。为此，我们提出了MoT3DVG，一个具有时间演化运动描述的大规模动态感知室外三维视觉定位数据集。该数据集包含来自nuScenes数据集的850个场景、31,128帧图像，并为跨时间的动态对象提供了144,568条带有运动感知描述的语言提示。我们进一步提出了DynaVG，一种有效利用时间线索进行室外三维视觉定位的新型框架。除了标准的模态特定编码器外，DynaVG在语言-点云对齐之前引入了短长时集成动态编码（SLIDE）模块。SLIDE通过短期窗口编码和长期窗口移位来建模局部运动线索和全局时间上下文。大量实验证明该方法在MoT3DVG上达到了最先进的性能，验证了运动感知编码的有效性。我们的工作揭示了室外三维视觉定位研究中的开放挑战和有前景的未来方向。

title: Where Should Models Run? A Collaborative Inference Framework for Embodied Intelligence in 6G
summary: Embodied intelligence systems rely on fast and reliable inference to enable real-time perception, reasoning, and control. Recent advances in large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have significantly enhanced the capabilities of embodied agents in complex environments. However, deploying these models remains challenging due to the limited computational resources and energy budgets of robotic platforms. A fundamental question is where inference should be executed. Collaborative inference, which partitions models across end devices, edge servers, and the cloud, has emerged as a promising solution. Yet determining the optimal partitioning point remains an open problem, as it depends on wireless network conditions, model structure, and privacy requirements. This article reviews the state of the art in collaborative inference for embodied intelligence and proposes an edge-centric framework in which the edge coordinates model partitioning and execution. Through both simulation and real-world experiments over WiFi and 5G networks, we demonstrate that the optimal partitioning strategy varies with network conditions and model structure. We further identify latency-minimizing partition points for ResNet-101, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and OpenVLA-7B in collaborative inference between NVIDIA Jetson Nano or AGX Xavier devices and an AGX Thor edge server under varying wireless conditions. Finally, we discuss the future directions for collaborative inference in 6G-empowered embodied intelligence systems.
tldr: This paper studies collaborative inference for embodied intelligence, proposing an edge-centric framework that partitions large models across devices, edge, and cloud, and empirically demonstrates latency-minimizing partition points for models like ResNet-101, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and OpenVLA-7B over WiFi and 5G.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了具身智能的协同推理，提出了一种边缘中心的框架，将大型模型在设备、边缘和云端之间进行划分，并通过实验展示了在WiFi和5G条件下针对ResNet-101、Qwen2.5-VL-7B和OpenVLA-7B等模型的最小延迟划分点。
summary_zh: 具身智能系统依赖于快速可靠的推理，以实现实时感知、决策和控制。近年来，大规模人工智能（AI）模型的进展，包括大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，显著提升了具身智能体在复杂环境中的能力。然而，由于机器人平台计算资源和能量预算有限，部署这些模型仍然面临挑战。一个根本性问题是推理应在何处执行。协同推理作为一种将模型拆分到端侧设备、边缘服务器和云端的方案，已成为一种有前景的解决方案。然而，确定最优的模型切分点仍然是一个开放性问题，因为它取决于无线网络条件、模型结构以及隐私需求。本文回顾了具身智能中协同推理的最新研究进展，并提出了一种以边缘为中心的计算框架，在该框架中，边缘端负责协调模型切分与执行。通过分别在WiFi和5G网络上进行的仿真与真实世界实验，我们证明了最优切分策略随网络条件和模型结构的变化而变化。此外，我们进一步确定了在NVIDIA Jetson Nano或AGX Xavier设备与AGX Thor边缘服务器之间进行协同推理时，ResNet-101、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 OpenVLA-7B 在不同无线条件下的时延最小化切分点。最后，我们探讨了在6G赋能的具身智能系统中协同推理的未来发展方向。

title: Reaching Is Not Finding: Map-Anchored Visual Prompting for the Last Mile of Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) asks a drone to find an object described in natural language. The description usually locates the object relative to named landmarks, such as streets and buildings. We observe that current navigators often bring the drone close to the target and then stop at the wrong place: they reach the target without finding it. This gap is shared by navigators of very different designs, from imitation learners to a fine-tuned 7B vision-language model. A simple test reveals the cause. When we replace the target object in the instruction with another one next to the same landmarks, no navigator goes to it, and most stop where they did before. Navigators learn to reach the landmarks, not to identify the described object. We therefore propose MAP-VP, a plug-and-play module for the last step. After any navigator stops, MAP-VP draws the landmarks named in the instruction onto the drone's current view, using the landmark outlines that the benchmark provides on a map. A fine-tuned 4B vision-language model then locates the target relative to these landmarks. The training data are generated automatically from the benchmark annotations. Neither drawing the landmarks nor fine-tuning helps much alone, but together they are highly effective. Without retraining any navigator, MAP-VP significantly improves all six navigators we test on CityNav. It roughly doubles the success rate of the two strongest trained navigators, raising HETT from 25.9% to 54.6% and FlightGPT from 24.2% to 48.9%, whereas CityNav's official detector-based last step adds less than two points to HETT.
tldr: This paper identifies a 'reach but not find' failure in aerial VLN and proposes MAP-VP, a plug-and-play visual prompting module that overlays map-derived landmark outlines onto the drone's view and uses a fine-tuned 4B VLM to locate the target, significantly improving navigation success on CityNav.
tldr_zh: 本文指出了空中视觉语言导航中“到达但未找到”的失败模式，并提出MAP-VP，一种即插即用的视觉提示模块，将地图地标轮廓叠加到无人机视野中，并利用微调的4B视觉语言模型定位目标，显著提升CityNav上的导航成功率。
summary_zh: 摘要：空中视觉语言导航（VLN）要求无人机找到自然语言中所描述的物体。该描述通常相对于已命名地标（如街道和建筑物）来定位目标物体。我们观察到，当前的导航器常常将无人机带到目标附近，却在错误的位置停下：它们到达了目标却没有识别出目标。这一差距普遍存在于设计迥异的各类导航器中，从模仿学习模型到微调过的70亿参数视觉语言模型皆不例外。一项简单测试揭示了原因——当我们将指令中的目标物体替换为同一地标旁的另一物体时，没有任何导航器能够飞向新目标，大多数导航器仍停在原处。这表明导航器学会的是到达地标，而非识别所描述的物体。为此，我们提出MAP-VP，一个即插即用的最后一步模块。在任何导航器停止后，MAP-VP利用基准测试在地图上提供的地标轮廓，将指令中提到的地标绘制到无人机的当前视野中。随后，一个经过微调的40亿参数视觉语言模型基于这些地标定位目标物体。训练数据由基准标注自动生成。单独绘制地标或单独微调模型效果有限，但二者结合则十分有效。在不重新训练任何导航器的情况下，MAP-VP显著提升了我们在CityNav上测试的全部六种导航器的性能。它将两个最强训练导航器的成功率大约提升了一倍，使HETT从25.9%提高到54.6%，FlightGPT从24.2%提高到48.9%，而CityNav官方的基于检测器的最后一步模块仅为HETT提升了不到两个百分点。

title: K-PWM: Control-Oriented Structured Bilinear World Models under Partial Observation
summary: World models learn internal simulators of environment dynamics for prediction, planning, and control, yet learning them from limited, noisy, and partial observations remains challenging. While much progress has focused on pixel-based observations, many physical systems instead provide vector-valued measurements that reveal only part of the underlying state. We introduce K-PWM, a probabilistic world model for prediction and control under partial observation. K-PWM couples Koopman-bilinear latent dynamics with a nonlinear observation decoder and performs probabilistic latent-state inference through the learned model via extended Kalman filtering and smoothing, without a separately trained inference network. Its bilinear structure enables exact propagation of the maintained Gaussian belief through the latent transition and efficient rollouts for uncertainty-aware model predictive path integral (MPPI) control. For training K-PWM, we present a generalized expectation conditional maximization (GECM) procedure with closed-form updates for the generators, noise covariances, and latent prior, complemented by gradient-based decoder learning. A Koopman-consistent initialization selects the latent dimension from data and initializes the action-dependent dynamics. With limited training data, K-PWM achieves lower long-horizon prediction error than the evaluated baselines on partially observed Gymnasium MuJoCo systems, while substantially reducing training time relative to the strongest prediction baseline. On high-dimensional MuJoCo Menagerie robots, it achieves competitive tracking accuracy with low per-step computation times, demonstrating potential for real-time deployment. These results support structured probabilistic dynamics as a data- and compute-efficient approach to world modeling and control under partial observation.
tldr: K-PWM introduces a Koopman-bilinear probabilistic world model for control under partial observation, using extended Kalman filtering for latent-state inference and achieving data/compute-efficient prediction and MPPI-based control on MuJoCo tasks.
tldr_zh: K-PWM 提出了一种基于 Koopman-双线性结构的概率世界模型，用于部分观测下的预测与控制，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波实现潜在状态推断，并在 MuJoCo 任务上实现了数据与计算高效的控制。
summary_zh: 世界模型学习环境动力学的内部模拟器，用于预测、规划和控制，然而从有限、含噪声且部分可观测的数据中学习这些模型仍然具有挑战性。尽管大量研究进展聚焦于基于像素的观测，许多物理系统反而提供仅揭示部分底层状态的向量值测量。我们提出了K-PWM，一种用于部分观测条件下预测与控制的概率世界模型。K-PWM将Koopman双线性潜动力学与非线性观测解码器相结合，并通过扩展卡尔曼滤波和平滑在所学模型中进行概率潜状态推断，无需单独训练的推断网络。其双线性结构使得所维护的高斯信念能够通过潜状态转移实现精确传播，并为不确定性感知的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制提供高效滚动推演。为训练K-PWM，我们提出了一种广义期望条件最大化（GECM）程序，对生成器、噪声协方差和潜先验采用闭式更新，并以基于梯度的解码器学习作为补充。一种Koopman一致的初始化方法从数据中选择潜维度并初始化依赖于动作的动力学。在有限训练数据条件下，K-PWM在部分观测的Gymnasium MuJoCo系统上实现了比所评估基线方法更低的长期预测误差，同时相比最强预测基线大幅减少了训练时间。在高维MuJoCo Menagerie机器人上，它以较低的每步计算时间实现了具有竞争力的跟踪精度，展现出实时部署的潜力。这些结果支持结构化概率动力学作为部分观测条件下世界建模与控制的一种数据和计算高效的方法。

title: Single-Radar Bilateral 3D Near-Field Imaging for Mobile Robots
summary: Mobile robots operating in homes need reliable 3D perception of nearby furniture and surrounding structures, yet recovering this information on both sides of the robot's path with a single forward-mounted millimeter-wave radar remains challenging because of near-field wavefront curvature, viewpoint-dependent target visibility, and limited elevation diversity. This paper presents a motion-assisted framework for reconstructing structures on both sides of a robot's trajectory. Our near-field model relates scene reflectivity to stepped-frequency multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) observations across frequencies and robot positions using spherical paths from transmitter (Tx) to scatterer to receiver (Rx). Bilateral Tx combining provides wideband directional weighting, while sliding-aperture back-projection coherently focuses the measurements using near-field propagation distances. Top-K power fusion combines local images with different visibility. The reconstruction provides lateral-forward support for multi-layer height extraction, followed by guarded adaptive height refinement using the original MIMO channels. Experiments in controlled, office/study, and corridor environments produce mean lateral-forward localization errors of 4.65, 5.63, and 5.98 cm, respectively, with peak-to-background ratios (PBRs) exceeding 13 dB. The framework recovers bilateral 3D scattering structure from one forward pass using a single radar, without relying on learned representations of the scene.
tldr: This paper presents a motion-assisted framework for single-radar bilateral 3D near-field imaging for mobile robots, enabling reconstruction of surrounding structures using near-field MIMO observations and back-projection without learned scene representations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于移动机器人的单雷达双边三维近场成像框架，通过近场MIMO观测和后向投影实现周围结构的重建，无需学习场景表示。
summary_zh: 移动机器人在家庭环境中作业时，需要对附近家具及周围结构具备可靠的3D感知能力。然而，仅使用单个前向安装的毫米波雷达，同时恢复机器人路径两侧的此类信息仍具挑战，原因在于近场波前曲率、视角依赖的目标可见性以及有限的俯仰分集。本文提出一种运动辅助框架，用于重建机器人轨迹两侧的结构。所提出的近场模型利用从发射天线（Tx）经散射体到接收天线（Rx）的球面传播路径，将场景反射率与跨频率和机器人位置的步进频多输入多输出（MIMO）观测相关联。双侧Tx合并提供了宽带方向性加权，而滑动孔径背向投影利用近场传播距离对测量结果进行相干聚焦。Top-K功率融合结合了具有不同可见性的局部图像。重建结果为多层高度提取提供侧向-前向支撑，随后利用原始MIMO通道进行带保护的适应性高度细化。在受控环境、办公室/书房及走廊环境中的实验分别产生了4.65、5.63和5.98 cm的平均侧向-前向定位误差，峰背比（PBR）均超过13 dB。该框架仅使用单个雷达，在单次前向扫描中即可恢复双侧3D散射结构，无需依赖场景的学习表示。

title: Tutorial: Vision-Based Formation Control with Differential-Drive Robots
summary: This tutorial presents a step-by-step introduction to multi-robot formation control using differential- drive robots, an overhead camera, and Python. ArUco markers are used to estimate robot positions and orientations, while desired pairwise displacement vectors define a circular formation. By comparing measured and desired relative positions, the controller computes movement vectors that are converted into differential-drive wheel commands, with basic proximity-sensor-based obstacle avoidance. The tutorial guides readers through hardware and software setup, robot pose estimation, formation geometry, feedback control, system integration, and formation-error evaluation. Motivated by the need to bridge the gap between theoretical understanding and practical implementation in robotics education, we emphasize how mathematical concepts are translated into coordinated behaviors on physical robots. Although the implementation uses a specific robotic platform, the underlying perception and formation-control principles can be adapted to other differential-drive robots and simulation environments. The accompanying open-source GitHub repository provides the Python implementation, setup instructions, and demonstrations to support hands-on learning and further exploration of multi-robot systems.
tldr: A tutorial for multi-robot formation control with differential-drive robots using an overhead camera and ArUco markers, bridging theory and practice with an open-source Python repository.
tldr_zh: 一个关于使用差分驱动机器人和顶部相机及ArUco标记进行多机器人编队控制的教程，弥合理论与实践并附带开源代码。
summary_zh: 本教程逐步介绍了如何使用差速驱动机器人、 overhead 摄像头和 Python 实现多机器人编队控制。利用 ArUco 标记估计机器人的位置和方向，同时通过期望的成对位移向量定义圆形编队。通过比较测量值与期望的相对位置，控制器计算移动向量，并将其转换为差速驱动轮指令，同时结合基于接近传感器的基础避障功能。本教程引导读者完成硬件与软件设置、机器人位姿估计、编队几何、反馈控制、系统集成以及编队误差评估。鉴于机器人教育中理论与实践之间存在差距，我们着重展示了数学概念如何转化为物理机器人上的协调行为。尽管实现采用了特定的机器人平台，但其中的感知与编队控制原理可适用于其他差速驱动机器人及仿真环境。随附的开源 GitHub 仓库提供了 Python 实现、设置说明和演示，以支持动手学习并进一步探索多机器人系统。

title: SoftPAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation with Deformables
summary: We present SoftPAT3D, a physics-augmented framework for text-to-3D scene generation in which deformable objects, such as cloth, stuffed toys and ropes, are generated as physically valid, simulation-ready bodies and placed in intersection-free contact with the furniture that supports them, with one another and with themselves. Existing physics-augmented pipelines simulate rigid bodies only and cannot accommodate a generated deformable object, which text-to-3D generation returns as a geometrically invalid mesh, sometimes self-intersecting, that has no rest shape, no material model and no admissible initial state. These are the inputs a deformable simulation requires, and we construct each from information already in the pipeline. The rest shape comes from how the object is manufactured rather than from the generated physically inconsistent deformed configuration, and a material library assigns each deformable object its initial elastic parameters, which can then be optimized. The occluded support is regenerated and converted into a watertight collision mesh, each object is released from an optimizable placement above the supporting part that the prompt specifies, and the complete scene is driven to static equilibrium under one unified contact model, with completion verified by geometric checks and a vision-language model. When a scene fails the prompt, a grid search over placements corrects it, and the adjoint of a differentiable simulation of the same contact energy reaches the targets the grid does not, places several bodies jointly and recovers and optimizes material parameters. Multi-body scenes equilibrate in a single simulation, and the pipeline also runs from the text prompt alone. On all sixty-five prompts, SoftPAT3D produces no undesired interpenetration of any kind, whereas every other system does, and its scenes directly support scene editing and robotic manipulation.
tldr: SoftPAT3D is a physics-augmented text-to-3D scene generation framework that creates physically valid deformable objects, such as cloth and ropes, and places them in contact with supports, enabling simulation-ready scenes for downstream robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: SoftPAT3D 是一个物理增强的文本到 3D 场景生成框架，可生成物理有效且可模拟的变形物体（如布料和绳索），并将其与支撑物接触放置，为下游机器人操作提供模拟就绪的场景。

title: DPDP: Diffusion Policy-Steered Diffusion Planner for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: In offline reinforcement learning, diffusion models fill two roles with complementary strengths. Typically guided by a critic, a diffusion policy is value-aware and favors high-return, behavior-supported actions, but it is short-sighted: it never lays out the states it intends to visit. A diffusion planner is far-sighted, synthesizing such a long-horizon trajectory, but it is only behavior-driven at execution, realizing each planned transition using only offline behavior.Each is strong exactly where the other is weak. We introduce DPDP to bring them together at the planner's execution step, where a planned transition becomes an action. Reading the planner's inverse-dynamics executor as a posterior over actions: the environment's transition likelihood relates an action to the planned next state, while the behavioral prior determines its weight under the offline data. Replacing this prior with a value-optimized diffusion policy preserves the planned transition likelihood and favors valuable actions that can serve the plan. We target the resulting clean-action distribution in two ways. A training-free sampler composes policy and inverse-dynamics scores at matched action noise levels and applies Langevin correction; this route uses a shared action noise schedule and an approximately common terminal prior. A preference objective instead amortizes the transfer into a single diffusion executor. Across D4RL, DPDP improves the planner it builds on, staying competitive with reactive diffusion policies on locomotion and leading on long-horizon navigation.
tldr: DPDP integrates a diffusion policy with a diffusion planner by replacing the planner's behavioral prior with a value-optimized diffusion policy, improving offline RL performance, particularly on long-horizon navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: DPDP 将扩散策略与扩散规划器相结合，通过用价值优化的扩散策略替换规划器的行为先验，提升了离线强化学习性能，尤其在长距离导航任务上表现突出。

title: Floquet-Parameterized Koopman-MPC for Tracking Periodic Orbits
summary: Designing real-time control for nonlinear systems to track periodic orbits can be challenging, especially for complex and coupled dynamical systems (e.g., tethered kites), where the true model parameters are hard to obtain. To address this, we propose a physics-informed Koopman learning approach that incorporates periodic-orbit stability directly into the learned linear predictor. The approach combines the underlying periodic structure of the dynamics along with periodic state-input trajectory data to learn physically consistent linear predictors (in lifted/observable space). We leverage Floquet theory, which studies the stability of periodic orbits in nonlinear systems, to obtain the periodic stability information of a given orbit via a monodromy matrix (i.e., the state transition matrix over an entire period). Subsequently, we impose open-loop monodromy constraints to learn Floquet-parameterized linear predictors using a least-squares Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition (EDMD) formulation, thereby constraining the search space and aiding in Koopman learning. We then utilize these linear predictors to design a model predictive control (MPC) law for tracking periodic references. Finally, we evaluate the designed framework on a cartpole system under periodic forcing and compare it against a purely data-driven baseline.
tldr: This paper proposes a physics-informed Koopman learning approach that incorporates periodic-orbit stability via Floquet theory into linear predictors for MPC, enabling real-time tracking of periodic orbits in nonlinear systems such as tethered kites.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种物理信息Koopman学习方法，利用Floquet理论将周期轨道稳定性引入线性预测器，并用于MPC，实现对非线性系统（如系留风筝）周期轨道的实时跟踪。

title: Cable construction effects on the lateral forces and wakes of helically stranded cables under oblique inflow
summary: Helically stranded cables in aerial towing systems experience oblique inflow, but are often modeled as smooth cylinders, neglecting three-dimensional cross-stream coupling and surface texture. We perform large-eddy simulations and spectral proper orthogonal decomposition for a smooth cylinder and four stranded cables at four inclinations from $22.5^\circ$ to $90^\circ$, all stationary, with $Re \approx 1.0 \times 10^4$. Aerodynamic differences are governed mainly by cross-sectional symmetry and strand-scale groove depth. Force-source decomposition shows that surface pressure contributes 94.9%--98.3% of the mean normal force and dominates the mean lateral force. High-symmetry, quasi-circular envelopes maintain balanced circumferential pressure, whereas deep-grooved, low-symmetry tri-lobed geometries produce asymmetric separation and a persistent lateral pressure imbalance. In the wake, high-symmetry cables sustain spanwise-synchronized Karman shedding at moderate-to-high inclinations, concentrating fluctuation energy in a dominant low-rank mode. Deep grooves disrupt shedding coherence, deflect the recirculation zone laterally, and spread energy across broadband scales. Mean lateral force and lateral-force fluctuations are therefore decoupled: the quasi-circular $(1 \times 19)$ cable has minimal mean lateral force but strong periodic fluctuations, while the deep-grooved $(3 \times 7)$ cable has weak fluctuations but appreciable mean lateral force. These results support construction-dependent cable selection and aerodynamic load modeling.
tldr: This paper investigates the aerodynamic forces and wake characteristics of helically stranded cables under oblique inflow using LES and SPOD, revealing that cross-sectional symmetry and groove depth determine lateral force and wake coherence, with implications for cable selection in aerial towing systems.
tldr_zh: 本文通过大涡模拟和谱本征正交分解研究了斜流下螺旋绞合电缆的气动力和尾迹特性，发现截面对称性和凹槽深度决定侧向力和尾迹相干性，为空中拖曳系统的电缆选择提供依据。

title: Beating the Pool, Not the Game: A White-Box Equilibrium Agent for Language-Based Economic Games
summary: We describe sudsho, a rule-based agent for the GLEE Competition that plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion with zero inference-time LLM calls. Games are scored as payoff percentiles against an empirical pool of prior play on the same configuration, so pool percentiles set our demand targets while clamped equilibrium shares bound demands and acceptance. Every move is a deterministic function of the visible state (persuasion mixing aside), so alignment is verified by replaying the post-freeze move log through the policy. Across 117,280 games the agent reached an overall rating of 2056 at $0 inference cost, and the account, ranked by its best agent (a same-policy replica), placed 26th of 71 ranked accounts. A replay against three frozen snapshots of the opponent pool credits the pool-aware clamp with 274 to 330 points of mean per-game bargaining rating, an effect that holds where logged opponent decisions fix the replay.
tldr: This paper presents a rule-based, white-box agent for language-based economic games (bargaining, negotiation, persuasion) that uses no inference-time LLM calls, relying instead on pool percentile targets and clamped equilibrium shares to achieve a high ranking at zero inference cost.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于基于语言的经济博弈（讨价还价、谈判、说服）的基于规则的白盒智能体，它在推理时不调用LLM，而是利用经验池百分位目标和受限均衡份额，以零推理成本获得高排名。

title: SurgWorld: Learning Surgical Representations Beyond Observation via Latent Prediction
summary: Surgical procedures are inherently partially observable, requiring surgeons to continuously infer evolving anatomical dynamics and future surgical states beyond the current observation. However, existing self-supervised learning methods primarily learn from observed surgical videos through masked reconstruction or predicting representations within the camera's current field of view, lacking the capability to explicitly model the out-of-sight surgical dynamics. Inspired by latent predictive world models, we introduce SurgWorld, a video-native, self-supervised framework for surgical representation learning, which treats a specified spatial or temporal shift as a pseudo-action and learns to predict the target latent representation from a partial observation. Specifically, we propose Out-of-Sight Dynamics Modeling (OSDM) as the pretraining objective for predicting representations conditioned on relative spatio-temporal shifts. We further regularize the learned latent dynamics from OSDM with a Geometric Visual Similarity (GVS) objective by aligning patch-level relational structures between predicted and target representations, preserving spatial geometry and local visual coherence for dense perception. These two objectives are integrated through an agglomerative training framework that consolidates complementary supervisory signals from multiple teachers to learn a unified latent representation of surgical dynamics and visual geometry. Extensive transfer learning experiments on 17 surgical benchmarks show that SurgWorld consistently outperforms existing vision foundation models across surgical workflow recognition, fine-grained action understanding, and dense visual perception. We further conduct tailored qualitative and quantitative analyses, demonstrating that SurgWorld effectively captures surgical dynamics beyond the directly observed context through latent prediction.
tldr: SurgWorld is a self-supervised video-native framework for surgical representation learning that uses latent predictive world models to model out-of-sight surgical dynamics and geometry, outperforming existing vision foundation models on 17 surgical benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SurgWorld 是一个用于手术表征学习的自监督视频原生框架，利用潜在预测世界模型来建模视野外的手术动态和几何结构，在17个手术基准上优于现有视觉基础模型。

title: A Hierarchical Tokenization Framework for Voxel-Level fMRI Representation Learning
summary: We introduce HBAR (Hierarchical Brain Activity Representation), a hierarchical tokenization framework for learning compact, multi-scale representations of neuroimaging data. HBAR organizes voxel-level resting-state fMRI into a hierarchy spanning sub-parcel voxel groups, parcels, and large-scale functional networks, enabling up to 415x compression while preserving fine-grained spatial information beyond conventional parcellation.
